{{Redirect|Paint|paint used in the Sailing skill|Boat paint}} {{Infobox Item |name = Goblin paint cannon |image = [[File:Goblin paint cannon.png]] |release = [[11 September]] [[2014]] |update = Optional Randoms & Goblins |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = No |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Wield, Destroy |destroy = You can get a replacement from Diango's Toy Store. |examine = A curious device made by goblins. |value = 150 |weight = 1.000 |id = 12727 }} [[File:Goblin paint cannon detail.png|left|150px]] [[File:Using goblin paint cannon.gif|frame|right|A player uses the goblin paint cannon.]] The '''goblin paint cannon''' is a [[Two-handed slot table|two-handed weapon]] that can be bought from [[Diango's Toy Store]] in [[Draynor Village]] for 225 [[coins]]. It was first introduced during the [[2014 Goblin Invasion]] event, when it could be obtained by speaking to either the [[Goblin Recruiter]] or the [[Guard Recruiter]], depending on whose side you joined. Opposing goblins or guards could be covered in paint using the cannon, which would make them attackable. It is one of the only four [[melee]] weapons with an [[attack speed]] of 3, with the other ones being the [[swift blade]], [[ham joint]], and [[mystic cards]], with the latter also being a two handed weapon. The swift blade also exclusively uses [[Stab]] and [[Slash]] attack styles whereas the others use [[Crush]], and the mystic cards have negative combat stat bonuses whereas the others have no bonuses. Because of this, it is commonly used with lower level [[PvP]] builds especially among players with 1 [[Attack]] where its attack speed out-performs other weapons of a similar tier like the [[iron scimitar]]. While having a goblin paint cannon equipped, other players will have a right-click "Paint" option listed in their [[choose option]] menu. Doing this will result in your character performing the [[Spin|spin emote]] before shooting out what looks like a huge ball of paint. The player will miss their shot in the majority of cases, causing the glob of paint to fly off in a random direction. However, there is a 1 in 15 chance the projectile will connect with the target when you right-click paint someone, which is confirmed by a message saying {{mes|By some miracle you hit the target!}} appearing in the chatbox.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1572193576947163140|date=20 September 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/105094|archivedate=20 September 2022|quote=[@JagexAsh When hitting players with the Paint option on the Goblin paint cannon (previously 360NoScope) what is the chance of getting a hit? Is it doing an actual attack roll?] It's a flat 1/15 roll.}} Using this ability will '''not''' deal damage in any way, regardless whether the target is a player or a NPC, or if the player is currently in [[PvP]] or the [[Wilderness]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = 2h |speed = 3 |attackrange = 1 |combatstyle = Unarmed |image = [[File:Goblin paint cannon equipped male.png|200px]] |altimage = [[File:Goblin paint cannon equipped female.png|200px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Unarmed|speed=3|attackrange=1}} ==Shop locations== {{Store locations list|Goblin paint cannon}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 5 June 2024 |update = Pride 2024 |type = hotfix |change = The goblin paint cannon is once again equipable. }} {{Subject changes |date = 5 June 2024 |update = Pride 2024 |change = The goblin paint cannon can no longer be equipped; attempting to do so results in a game message stating {{mes|You can't equip this item at the time.}} }} {{Subject changes |date = 14 September 2022 |update = Quest Speedrunning, Wilderness Boss Rework Rewards & Poison Dynamite Betas |type = |change = * The item's name was changed from "Event rpg" to "Goblin paint cannon". * The item's examine text was changed; previously, it was ''"A Rocket Paint Gun."'' }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 30 October –
20 November 2014 |change = The item was made available to free-to-play players. }} {{Subject changes |date = 2 October 2014 |update = Content Poll 25 - Batch 1 |change = You can now claim the goblin paint cannon from [[Diango]] in [[Draynor village]]. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== * Prior to being renamed in September 2022, the weapon's right-click option on players was "360NoScope-paint", and was a reference to the 360-No-Scope internet meme, in which a player in a {{wp|shooter game}} spins around 360 degrees and instantly kills another player with a sniper rifle weapon without using its scope. *Despite being a weapon, the Goblin paint cannon can be brought to [[Entrana]] and into [[Glarial's Tomb]]. *Despite its behaviour as a ranged weapon, it is classified as a melee weapon. *This item's original name is a nod to the [[fixed device]]'s unique appearance resembling an {{wp|Rocket-propelled grenade|RPG}}. *The inventory icon of the goblin paint cannon appears to be upside down. *The exhaust of the goblin paint cannon is made up of nine small doors, specifically the door to the garden shed in [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]]. ==References== {{reflist}} {{2014 Goblin Invasion}} {{Diango's Toy Store}}
